items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: FAQ questions and answers. Native details and summary, ringed like cards.

items.name: announcement-dot-strip
items.title: AnnouncementDotStrip
items.description: The animated dot strip behind the announcement bar.

items.name: app-bar-chart
items.title: AppBarChart
items.description: Usage over time. A stacked bar a bucket, each series a band in its color, a value axis, three dates and a legend that picks a series out.

items.name: app-block
items.title: AppBlock
items.description: The root element of every product block (app-*). Names the block and opts it into the first-visit entrance.

items.name: app-button
items.title: AppButton
items.description: Every action in the product. 8px corners, 12.6px label, sentence case, an optional leading icon.

items.name: app-card
items.title: AppCard
items.description: The white card every product panel sits in. Hairline edge and soft shadow, 10px corners, optional header and footer.

items.name: app-copy-button
items.title: AppCopyButton
items.description: Copying a value (an API key, a code sample, a command) with one click. useCopy for a copy action with its own label.

items.name: app-dialog
items.title: AppDialog
items.description: Product dialogs (create a key, confirm a delete, pick a plan). A white box in a glass frame over a light scrim, near the top of the window.

items.name: app-dot-glyph
items.title: AppDotGlyph
items.description: Small icons drawn on the dot grid (the credits gem, plan marks), where a product icon should speak the brand's dot language.

items.name: app-empty-state
items.title: AppEmptyState
items.description: A section with nothing made yet (no batches, no monitors), or a card before its first run. A fine-dot picture, what the section does, and the one next action.

items.name: app-field
items.title: AppField
items.description: A labeled form control in the product. AppField (label, help, error) around AppInput or AppTextarea.

items.name: app-hold-button
items.title: AppHoldButton
items.description: A destructive action (delete a key, remove a member, delete an account) that fires only after being held for 1.2s.

items.name: app-icon-button
items.title: AppIconButton
items.description: An icon-only action (close, row menu, search, reveal, copy). A square ghost button that always carries a tooltip.

items.name: app-menu
items.title: AppMenu
items.description: Every dropdown in the product. SelectMenu picks one value (filters, form selects, chart periods); ActionMenu is the overflow menu at the end of a table row.

items.name: app-scroll-area
items.title: AppScrollArea
items.description: A panel or card body that may run taller than its space (parameters panel, long lists, onboarding steps). Fades at the edges with more beyond, and offers a chevron to scroll on.

items.name: app-secret-field
items.title: AppSecretField
items.description: Showing a secret (an API key, a webhook secret) masked, with reveal and copy. SecretText for a masked value in a table cell.

items.name: app-skeleton
items.title: AppSkeleton
items.description: Loading states. Skeleton is one shimmering block; LoadingGate swaps a page's skeleton for the page when its data arrives.

items.name: app-status
items.title: AppStatus
items.description: The state of a job, monitor, key or request. AppStatus draws it as a dot, a mono label, a code pill or a haloed dot; AppSpinner and AppProgressBar show work under way.

items.name: app-switch
items.title: AppSwitch
items.description: An on or off setting that applies at once (Main content only, Include frames, a Parameters panel toggle).

items.name: app-table
items.title: AppTable
items.description: Every list of records in the product (API keys, batches, monitors, team members, invites). A white card with a gray header row, hairline row dividers and a menu at the end of each row.

items.name: app-tabs
items.title: AppTabs
items.description: Switching views on a page (Personal, Organization, Billing) or picking one value in a form or chart (7D, 30D, 3M). AppSegmentedControl is the radio form.

items.name: app-tags-input
items.title: AppTagsInput
items.description: A field for a list of short values (domains, URLs, CSS selectors, emails) entered as removable tags.

items.name: app-theme
items.title: AppTheme
items.description: The product's light, dark and system themes. THEME_SCRIPT for the root layout, hooks, and the three-option theme switch.

items.name: app-tooltip
items.title: AppTooltip
items.description: The label for an icon-only control or a truncated value. Appears beside or above its trigger on hover or keyboard focus.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A one or two word status next to a title ("Recommended", "Beta").

items.name: benchmark-chart
items.title: BenchmarkPanel
items.description: The homepage benchmark panel from context.dev: tabs for success rate, latency and cost vs success, drawn as dot meters over a ring backdrop, with values in Doto.

items.name: blog-cover
items.title: BlogCoverArt
items.description: Animated dot cover art for a post card. Six motifs, on paper (white) or blue.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Every action. Pill, 1px border, 16px label, sentence case.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: The ringed card. White card inside a blue 10 ring, or a blue card inside a blue 80 ring.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A binary choice with a visible label. Also the check items under the hero demo (disabled, checked).

items.name: chip
items.title: Chip
items.description: Small tags under a card title ("Fresh sources for RAG") and "Also in the API" links.

items.name: code-window
items.title: CodeWindow
items.description: SDK samples and the agent setup prompt. Window with three dots (first solid), title or tabs, copy.

items.name: credits-dot-number
items.title: CreditsDotNumber
items.description: A figure drawn in dots that morphs into Doto, such as 1,000 free credits or a step number.

items.name: customer-logo-dots
items.title: CustomerLogoDots
items.description: A customer logo sampled into the dot grid, white on a blue story card.

items.name: cx
items.title: Cx
items.description: Join and merge class names. A class passed in replaces the default it conflicts with. Every registry component uses it.

items.name: demo-input
items.title: DemoInput
items.description: The homepage hero demo. Pick a job (Scrape, Search, Research, Crawl, Map, Brand) and type a URL or question.

items.name: dot-engine
items.title: resolveColor
items.description: The shared dot animation engine: eased hollow and solid dots, liquid fusion, glyph morphs, story timing. Used by every animated dot item.

items.name: dot-grid
items.title: DotGrid
items.description: Static dot drawings and simple patterns. For the animated pictures from context.dev, use dot-story.

items.name: dot-panel
items.title: DotPanel
items.description: The ring-filled panel the site sets its one interactive or code element on (the hero demo, the code showcase).

items.name: dot-story
items.title: DotScene
items.description: The animated dot pictures from context.dev. Each scene is a looping story drawn in the brand dot grid.

items.name: footer-watermark
items.title: FooterWatermark
items.description: The giant dotted context.dev wordmark at the bottom of the footer, with its cursor.

items.name: hero-dot-field
items.title: HeroDotField
items.description: The hero dot field: a live pattern with the logo cut from it, and optional stat morphs.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Single-line text fields. Always labelled.

items.name: logo
items.title: Logo
items.description: The Context.dev logo. Logomark, horizontal or vertical combination mark, in the approved colorways.

items.name: page-guides
items.title: PageGuides
items.description: The dashed outer guides of a marketing page. Rendered by every template, never by blocks.

items.name: ring-backdrop
items.title: RingBackdrop
items.description: A faint field of hollow rings behind art or a card, clipped to whole rings.

items.name: section
items.title: Section
items.description: The outer shell of every block. Surface, ruled center column with dot nodes, vertical rhythm, data-ds-block.

items.name: section-heading
items.title: SectionHeading
items.description: The heading of every section. Headline with the key phrase in blue, one line of muted sub, optional action on the right.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Choosing one of a short list (plan, SDK language). Native select for accessibility.

items.name: stat
items.title: Stat
items.description: One large, provable figure in Doto with a one-line label ("94%" of pages returned as clean content).

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Data that people compare across rows: credit costs, plan limits, benchmark numbers. Tables, not cards, for data.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Switching between 2 to 6 parallel views of one thing (benchmark metrics, FAQ topics, SDK languages).

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Multi-line text, such as the FAQ "Ask anything" box or a contact message.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short label for an icon-only control or an abbreviation. Hover and focus.

items.name: trust-mark
items.title: TrustMark
items.description: Animated dot marks for the trust cards: SOC 2, security policies, security controls.

items.name: agent-onboarding
items.title: AgentOnboarding
items.description: The two ways to start, side by side. Do it yourself (white card), or let your agent do it (blue card, recommended).

items.name: announcement-bar
items.title: AnnouncementBar
items.description: One line above the nav announcing one new API or feature, with a link.

items.name: app-banner
items.title: AppBanner
items.description: A card-wide note above a list, usually a plan limit and the way past it ("You’ve used 1 of 2 API keys").

items.name: app-chart-card
items.title: AppChartCard
items.description: The overview's usage chart. One card with a breakdown picker as its title, a range switch at the right and a stacked bar chart.

items.name: app-code-card
items.title: AppCodeCard
items.description: Code a user copies into their app or agent (the playground call, a form's API equivalent). Code on the card, copy in the corner, one quiet footer for language, fold and agents.

items.name: app-composer
items.title: AppComposer
items.description: The playground's request bar. One field, the Parameters toggle, and the brand run button that carries its credit cost.

items.name: app-data-table
items.title: AppDataTable
items.description: A list page's toolbar and table card (API keys, batches, monitors, team). Search, tabs or one filter, rows as data, row menus, pagination.

items.name: app-detail-card
items.title: AppDetailCard
items.description: The body of a detail page (a batch, a run, a request). Status head, gray detail lists in titled sections, and a paged results list.

items.name: app-empty-page
items.title: AppEmptyPage
items.description: The whole page of a list feature before anything exists (batches, monitors). A dot story, what the feature is for, one brand action, the docs, the plan limit.

items.name: app-form-panel
items.title: AppFormPanel
items.description: A create or edit form (new batch, new monitor). Mode bar, fields as data, an Advanced disclosure, and a footer that says the cost beside the brand submit.

items.name: app-page-header
items.title: AppPageHeader
items.description: The head of every product page. Centered title, one muted sentence, the page's actions under it. A back link (forms) or breadcrumb (detail pages) above.

items.name: app-parameters-panel
items.title: AppParametersPanel
items.description: The playground's docked parameters panel. Output-format toggles, then groups of parameter rows in soft gray boxes, with a changed count and Reset.

items.name: app-quickstart
items.title: AppQuickstart
items.description: The overview's quickstart card. Numbered steps from signing up to a first call. Copy the key, set up an agent with one snippet, paste one prompt.

items.name: app-result-card
items.title: AppResultCard
items.description: What a playground call returned. A tabs row above the card with the response status, and the card's states from ready to result.

items.name: app-settings-section
items.title: AppSettingsSection
items.description: One titled group on a settings page (auto-join, data retention, SSO, the Danger zone). A small label over a white card of rows, each a sentence and one control.

items.name: app-sidebar
items.title: AppSidebar
items.description: The product's navigation, in the app-shell's sidebar slot. Workspace switcher, search, grouped links, help links and the account menu. A drawer below md.

items.name: app-stat-cards
items.title: AppStatCards
items.description: A few headline figures as small cards, two by two (credits used, remaining, plan). Each card that leads somewhere is a link.

items.name: app-top-bar
items.title: AppTopBar
items.description: The bar above every product page, in the app-shell's topbar slot. The drawer's menu button (below md) and the credits menu at the right.

items.name: benchmark
items.title: Benchmark
items.description: The proof that Context.dev is better and cheaper. The live site's benchmark panel, with a sourced feature table while the figures are unverified.

items.name: blog-grid
items.title: BlogGrid
items.description: The latest six posts on a black band, cards alternating white and blue, each with animated dot cover art.

items.name: code-showcase
items.title: CodeShowcase
items.description: Show the real SDK call for each job, one tab per job, description left and code right.

items.name: credit-costs
items.title: CreditCosts
items.description: What each API costs in credits, grouped by product area, as tables.

items.name: cta-band
items.title: CtaBand
items.description: The closing section of every page. One headline, one line of sub, the free offer and one outline action.

items.name: faq
items.title: Faq
items.description: Questions that remove doubt before sign-up. Heading and one action on the left, questions on the right.

items.name: feature-trio
items.title: FeatureTrio
items.description: Three things you control with one API, side by side, each with an animated dot scene.

items.name: footer
items.title: Footer
items.description: The site footer on black. Logo, tagline, four link columns, compliance, status, legal links, dotted watermark.

items.name: hero
items.title: Hero
items.description: Top of a marketing page. One message, one filled primary action, one outline secondary.

items.name: logo-wall
items.title: LogoWall
items.description: Proof right under the hero. Six or twelve customer names, one outline link to their stories.

items.name: nav
items.title: Nav
items.description: The top navigation on every marketing page. Logo, five links, "Book demo", "Start for free".

items.name: pricing-table
items.title: PricingTable
items.description: The plan comparison on the pricing page. One column per plan, price, credits, limits, one action each.

items.name: product-grid
items.title: ProductGrid
items.description: The four core APIs as a 2x2 grid of ringed cards, plus a row of links to the rest of the API.

items.name: related-products
items.title: RelatedProducts
items.description: Two neighbouring APIs at the end of a product page, as linked cards.

items.name: steps
items.title: Steps
items.description: Three numbered steps from sign-up to a working feature, with the heading and one action on the left.

items.name: story-rail
items.title: StoryRail
items.description: Customer stories as a horizontal row of blue cards the visitor scrolls themselves.

items.name: testimonials
items.title: Testimonials
items.description: Three short customer quotes with name, role and a link to the case study.

items.name: trust-grid
items.title: TrustGrid
items.description: Security and reliability for the buyer who spends 100k. Three cards and a link to the trust center.

items.name: use-case-grid
items.title: UseCaseGrid
items.description: What teams build with the API. Two or six ringed cards in a two-column grid, each with a dot drawing.

items.name: app-detail
items.title: AppDetailTemplate
items.description: One record's page (a batch, a monitor run, a request). Breadcrumb back to the list, then the record's status and its sections.

items.name: app-form
items.title: AppFormTemplate
items.description: A create or edit page (new batch, new monitor, edit monitor). Back link, centered header, then the form with its cost and submit.

items.name: app-list
items.title: AppListTemplate
items.description: A list of records (API keys, batches, monitors, members). Header with the one brand action, then the table, or the first-run empty state.

items.name: app-overview
items.title: AppOverviewTemplate
items.description: The dashboard home. Try an API, see usage over time, get started, and read the credit figures at a glance.

items.name: app-playground
items.title: AppPlaygroundTemplate
items.description: An API's playground. Make a request, see the code for the same call, read what came back, tune parameters.

items.name: app-settings
items.title: AppSettingsTemplate
items.description: Settings. Centered header with tabs (Personal, Organization, Billing), then titled sections of rows, the danger zone last.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: AppShellTemplate
items.description: The dashboard layout. Sidebar and top bar around every product page. Scaffolds layout.tsx, not a page.

items.name: landing
items.title: LandingTemplate
items.description: The homepage and campaign landing pages. One message, one primary action, the agent path next to it.

items.name: pricing
items.title: PricingTemplate
items.description: The pricing page. Plans, credit costs as a table, the FAQ that removes doubt, one close.

items.name: product
items.title: ProductTemplate
items.description: A page for one API (Search, Scrape, Research, Monitors, Map, Crawl, Batches, Brand). What it returns, the code, how to start.
